d: taawoni is a forward-thinking company at the intersection of artificial intelligence and accounting, dedicated to revolutionizing financial processes through cutting-edge technology. We are seeking a talented and innovative AI Engineer to join our dynamic team and help us design, develop, and implement AI-driven solutions tailored specifically for the accounting industry. The ideal candidate will leverage expertise in machine learning, natural language processing, and data analytics to create intelligent systems that optimize accounting operations, enhance accuracy, and provide actionable insights. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to transforming traditional accounting practices into efficient, automated workflows that adapt to evolving business needs. As an AI Engineer at taawoni, you will collaborate closely with accounting professionals, data scientists, and software engineers to build scalable AI models and tools that empower users and drive strategic decision-making. We value creativity, technical excellence, and a passion for solving complex problems using state-of-the-art AI technologies. Join us in shaping the future of accounting by delivering innovative AI solutions that streamline tasks such as auditing, forecasting, risk assessment, and compliance management. If you are eager to make a significant impact in a thriving industry through AI innovation, taawoni is the perfect place to grow your career and push the boundaries of what’s possible.
q: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
Proven experience in developing AI and machine learning models, preferably in the financial or accounting domain.
Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, R, or Java, with proficiency in AI frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.
Deep understanding of machine learning algorithms, natural language processing, and data analytics techniques.
Experience working with large datasets, data preprocessing, and feature engineering.
Familiarity with accounting principles, financial regulations, or enterprise accounting software is a strong plus.
Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
r: li
Design, develop, and implement AI models and algorithms tailored to accounting applications.
li
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including accountants, data scientists, and software developers to understand business requirements and translate them into AI solutions.
li
Build and optimize machine learning pipelines to automate accounting workflows and improve operational efficiency.
li
Conduct research and experimentation to identify new AI techniques suitable for financial data analysis and decision support.
li
Develop natural language processing tools for automating document analysis, auditing, and reporting tasks.
li
Ensure the scalability, reliability, and security of AI systems deployed within the accounting environment.
li
Maintain clear documentation and communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
li
Monitor AI system performance and make continuous improvements based on feedback and evolving business needs.
